methodology.delayed_ground_truth: An evaluation-positive hour has labelled_fraud_rate >= early-period mean + 2 standard deviations. isFraud is not a live input.
methodology.split: First 70% of relative-hour buckets are the reference window; the remainder is the temporal holdout.

pr_auc.reason: No trained scoring model exists. PR-AUC is not reported for the deterministic heuristic detector.

notes: These scores evaluate hour-level heuristic flags, not a transaction classifier.
Precision/recall can be low because elevated volume is not the same as elevated fraud.
Do not present these numbers as model-training results.
